entries.title: Amos 7:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Thus - This is the first of five prophetic representations of what was coming upon this people. The latter growth - The shooting up of the first growth being too luxuriant, they often eat it down with cattle; but if the second growth were eat up, it marred the whole harvest. Mowed - It is supposed the first mowing of the corn in the blade was for the king's use; and after this the second springing grew up to the harvest.

entries.title: Amos 7:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: It came to pass - In the vision. By whom - How shall any of Jacob escape, if thou dost cast him down?

entries.title: Amos 7:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Repented - This is spoken after the manner of men.

entries.title: Amos 7:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Shewed - In vision. Called - Commanded fire from heaven. A part - Of the land too.

entries.title: Amos 7:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: By a plumb - line - Strongly and beautifully built.

entries.title: Amos 7:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Set a plumb - line - I will exactly measure the whole ten tribes. Pass by them - I will no more forbear, but will pull down all that is faulty.

entries.title: Amos 7:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The high places - The temples on high mountains built to idols. Of Isaac - The seed of Isaac.

entries.title: Amos 7:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: In the midst - Openly, and publickly, endeavouring to stir up Israel to sedition or rebellion. The land - The people cannot bear all his harsh predictions.

entries.title: Amos 7:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Jeroboam shall die - He nowhere said so, but spake of his house distinguished from his person, as ver. 9 .

entries.title: Amos 7:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The king's court - To which therefore thou oughtest to shew more respect, and not thus to affront the king in his own house.

entries.title: Amos 7:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: No prophet - Not originally, or by study, or by any human designation. An herdman - By breeding and occupation I was and still am, an herdman. Sycamore fruit - This fruit was good food for man, or cattle.

entries.title: Amos 7:16
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The house of Isaac - The posterity of Isaac.

entries.title: Amos 7:17–8:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: In a polluted land - Among the Heathen. Israel - The ten tribes.
